title: Office Walk
brief: You walk the Meridian Advisory office, which delivers financial reviews and training courses for clients, as an internal auditor before the certification audit. Cover scoping, delivery, review, client sign-off, and aftercare. You have 12 visit points.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: How original client documents are returned
Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: All 7 engagement letters this month define scope and deliverables and are signed.
2 analysts use report template version 5; version 6, with a revised disclaimer section, was approved 4 weeks ago.
Valuation model VM-3 was edited last week (cell formula change in sheet 4) with no verification record.
evidence.whyItMatters: Calculation models are measuring resources; changes need verification.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask how model changes are checked.

evidence.text: Client folder CL-118 on the shared drive is open to all 45 staff.
evidence.whyItMatters: Client confidential information must be protected.

evidence.text: Peer review records for last month's 12 reports are complete.
1 of 5 deliverables sent this week (report R-2207) has no peer review record.
evidence.whyItMatters: Deliverables should be released after planned review or authorized decision.
evidence.missedExplanation: Compare sent deliverables with review records.

evidence.text: Course feedback for quarter 3 is collected; 4 comments on unclear assessment criteria have no action (summary CF-3).
evidence.whyItMatters: Feedback should be analyzed and used.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask what was done with feedback.

evidence.text: Office manager: "Original client documents go back by courier when someone remembers." Register of client originals RO-1 shows 6 items held over 90 days.
evidence.whyItMatters: A defined return process would protect client property.

evidence.text: Meeting room booking sheet is on paper.

options: Restrict access to client folder CL-118 and check report R-2207 with the client after a peer review
decisions.rationale: Client confidentiality and an unreviewed deliverable come first.

containment: Restrict CL-118 access; peer review R-2207 and inform the client of any change
correction: Replace template version 5, verify VM-3, act on feedback, and return client originals
cause: Access, template, and model controls rely on individual habit
corrective: Default client folders to restricted access, lock old templates, and require verification of model changes
effectiveness: Repeat the walk in three months

debriefText.missed: Folder permissions are easy to overlook.
debriefText.falseFinding: Photos and paper booking sheets are not findings.
